output.name: CartNudge
output.tagline: In-cart upsells that know what's in the basket
output.description: CartNudge adds native in-cart and post-purchase upsell offers to Shopify stores — no popups, no theme edits, one-click install. Offers are generated automatically from your own order history. Flat $19/month, no revenue share. Pilot cohort averaged +9.4% AOV across 60 stores.
output.first_comment:
Hey Product Hunt — I'm the builder behind CartNudge, and I want to be straight with you about what this is and isn't.

The problem I kept hearing from Shopify merchants: every upsell app either blasts customers with popups that tank conversion, or takes a cut of every upsell dollar — which gets painful fast once it's working. So I built CartNudge to do neither.

Offers render natively inside the cart drawer. No modal, no overlay, no interruption. The suggestions come from the store's own order history — what customers actually buy together — not a generic algorithm. Install is one click, zero theme code touched.

Pricing is flat $19/month with a 14-day free trial. No revenue share, no per-order fees.

The honest limitations: it's Shopify-only right now — no WooCommerce or BigCommerce support. There's no built-in A/B testing of offers yet (it's on the roadmap). And we have 22 App Store reviews so far, so the social proof is still early.

The pilot cohort of 60 stores averaged +9.4% AOV lift, and the first 22 reviews landed at 5.0 stars — but I'd rather you try it and tell me what's broken than take my word for it.

If you run a Shopify store doing 100+ orders a month and AOV is the lever you haven't pulled yet, I'd love your feedback. What would make this a no-brainer for you?
warnings: The +9.4% AOV figure is from the vendor's own pilot cohort of 60 stores — disclose this context on the PH listing to avoid community pushback.
Review count (22) is small; PH commenters may flag this — the first_comment proactively acknowledges it, which is the right call.
No invented metrics or testimonials used — all proof points sourced directly from APP_PROFILE.proof_points.
